stem: A binary search or a linear search can be used to look for a specific value in an array.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete this pseudocode algorithm for a linear search.

```text
DECLARE MyList : ARRAY[0:9] OF INTEGER
DECLARE MaxIndex : INTEGER
DECLARE Index : INTEGER
DECLARE Found : BOOLEAN
DECLARE ValueToFind : [[blank]]

INPUT ValueToFind
Found ← FALSE
Index ← 0
MaxIndex ← [[blank]]

REPEAT
    IF MyList[Index] = ValueToFind THEN
        Found ← TRUE
    ENDIF
    Index ← [[blank]]
UNTIL Found OR Index > MaxIndex

IF Found THEN
    OUTPUT "Value found at position ", Index
ELSE
    OUTPUT [[blank]]
ENDIF
```
